trial_court: learned District Judge at Krishnanagar, Nadia (Matrimonial Suit No. 405 of 2013); learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court at Alipore (Matrimonial Suit No. 103 of 2013)
facts_of_case: The wife filed a petition under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of Matrimonial Suit No. 103 of 2013 filed by the husband in the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court at Alipore to the learned District Judge, Krishnanagar, Nadia.

legal_principles.principle: In such circumstances, it would be appropriate to transfer the case in one court to hear both the proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Considering the respective submissions and materials on record, I find that the petitioner had instituted the Matrimonial Suit No. 405 of 2013 prior in point of time i.e., on April 12, 2013.

legal_principles.principle: Matrimonial Suit No. 103 of 2013 pending before the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court at Alipore is transferred to the learned District Judge, Krishnanagar, Nadia.
legal_principles.held: In such circumstances, Matrimonial Suit No. 103 of 2013 pending before the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court at Alipore is transferred to the learned District Judge, Krishnanagar, Nadia.

outcome.final_order: Matrimonial Suit No. 103 of 2013 pending before the learned Additional District Judge, 7th Court at Alipore is transferred to the learned District Judge, Krishnanagar, Nadia where Matrimonial Suit No. 405 of 2013 is pending.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of proceedings in a divorce case
advising on the grounds for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
assisting with a judicial transfer application
